title: Law to create LGBTQ shelters in every borough
summary: This bill would require the Department of Social Services to open at least one shelter for LGBTQ single adults in each borough by January 1, 2028. The shelters must provide services such as referrals to education, employment, counseling and healthcare, including HIV and transgender care. The department must report by January 1, 2029 on each shelter's cost, number of residents and effectiveness.
